spec.description: volkeep backup daemon: pass outcomes, durations, and failures across the fleet.

spec.title: Active Hosts
spec.description: Hosts with a successful backup in the last 36 h — a fixed window, not the selected range.

spec.expr: count(count by (hostname) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` [36h])))

spec.title: Repo Overview
spec.description: Snapshots in repo is current inventory, ≈ retention days (same-day snapshots collapse under keep-daily). Logical = uncompressed, physical = on-disk; Added in range = packed bytes written, before prune.

spec.expr: count by (hostname) (label_replace(node_uname_info{job="integrations/unix", nodename=~"$hostname"}, "hostname", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))
sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap snapshots [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass finished"` | logfmt | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_uncompressed_size [$__range])) / max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_uncompressed_size [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000
sum by (hostname) (sum_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | logfmt | unwrap data_added_packed [$__range]))

spec.title: Recent Backups
spec.description: One row per volume backup. Size = data read (logical); Added = new data before compression, – = unchanged; Stopped / Exec = container stopped / pre-hook ran

spec.expr: {syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `msg="Backup (finished|failed|completed)` | logfmt | keep hostname, volume, duration_ms, exit, msg, bytes_processed, data_added, stopped, exec

value.title: View daemon log for this backup

spec.title: Backups
spec.description: All volume backups in range, failures included.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `msg="Backup (finished|failed|completed)` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Volume Size
spec.description: Logical size of the backed-up data per volume.

spec.expr: max by (hostname, volume) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | logfmt | volume=~`$volume` | unwrap bytes_processed [$__interval]))

spec.title: Pass Duration
spec.description: Whole pass per host: all volumes plus forget/sweep/prune/check.

spec.expr: max by (hostname) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass finished"` | logfmt | unwrap duration_ms [$__interval]))

spec.title: Backup Duration by Volume
spec.description: Failed backups excluded.

spec.expr: avg by (hostname, volume) (avg_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | logfmt | volume=~`$volume` | unwrap duration_ms [$__interval]))

spec.title: Repository Size
spec.description: Physical (on-disk) repository size per host.

spec.expr: max by (hostname) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [$__interval]))

spec.title: Total Repo Size
spec.description: Latest known physical repository size per host (2 d lookback), summed.

spec.expr: sum(max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [2d])))

spec.title: Daemon Log
spec.description: Every daemon line, or errors only via the Errors only switch. Worker (restic) stdout is a separate stream, not shown.

spec.expr: {syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} | logfmt | level=~`$errors_only` | regexp `^time=\S*?(?P<tz>[+-][0-9:]{5}|Z) ` | line_format `host={{.hostname}} tz={{ regexReplaceAll "^Z$" .tz "+00:00" }} {{ regexReplaceAll "^time=\\S+ level=\\S+ " (__line__) "" }}`

spec.title: Passes Over Time
spec.description: Whole-host backup passes per interval, split by trigger. The trigger attr ships with the pass-counters build; earlier passes do not chart.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass starting"` | logfmt | trigger=`schedule` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass starting"` | logfmt | trigger=`manual` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Recent Passes
spec.description: One row per whole-host pass. Failed counts volumes not backed up. Rows before the pass-counters build carry only Finished, Host, and Duration.

spec.expr: {syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass finished"` | logfmt | keep hostname, trigger, containers, volumes, failed, data_added, duration_ms

value.title: View volume backups from this pass

spec.title: Passes
spec.description: Whole-host backup passes in range.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass starting"` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Failure Rate
spec.description: Failed share of volume backups over the trailing 24 h.

spec.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup failed"` [1d])) / sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `msg="Backup (finished|failed|completed)` [1d]))

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: All ERROR-level daemon events in range (backup, forget, sweep, prune, check, exec).

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `level=ERROR` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Warnings
spec.description: WARN-level daemon events: partial backups with unreadable files, stale lock removals.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `level=WARN` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Check Failures
spec.description: Repository integrity checks that failed in range.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository check failed"` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Backups Over Time
spec.description: Volume backups per interval.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup failed"` [$__interval]))

spec.title: volkeep

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only errors in the Daemon Log.
